title: —Parnell! Parnell! He is dead!
html_source: Charles Stewart Parnell, a leading Irish politician, who died in 1891. Parnell appears throughout the novel as a topic of discussion, and was a critical figure of the time.

anchor.prefix:
nd towards the people and heard him say in a loud voice of sorrow over the waters:

 —He is dead. We saw him lying upon the catafalque. A wail of sorrow went up from the people.
anchor.suffix:
They fell upon their knees, moaning in sorrow.

 And he saw Dante in a maroon velvet dress and with a green velvet mantle hanging from her shoulders walking proudly and silently
